Class SummaryDialogFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.SummaryDialogFactory

  • final class SummaryDialogFactory
extends java.lang.Object
    Factory class responsible for constructing and displaying the batch processing summary dialog.

    Provides interactive features such as dynamic file size formatting, contextual menus, double-click file opening, multi-selection row dragging, CSV clipboard copying, dynamic status bar, and debounced hover image previews.

    Since:
    19 September 2026
    Version:
    1.4
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs
